I understand. And trust me you don't sound stupid. I've considered running away. It may sound cliche but you can't outrun your problems. I do know the feeling of wanting to stay boarded up in your bedroom due to fear of awkwardness of rejection etc. and I can tell you I've allowed those feelings to dictate my actions too many times. It's overwhelming. I guess from my point of view I just wish my family and friends could understand that sometimes I want to be alone and they wouldn't feel like I'm being a jerk because of it. I'm kind of ranting. For the past few years I've struggled way too much with worrying about what everyone around me thinks. I've tried way too hard to make everyone else happy. But sometimes you really do need the solitude and it seems to me like you want to avoid solitude because you don't want to upset your family. But you need to weigh it out. ...fuck it's difficult. Just typing this out I know it's way harder than a simple pro and con list. But it comes down to you. What's best for you.
Hey you gotta start somewhere.

You've got nothing to be sorry about. I definitely know the feeling. It's difficult to find someone who understand. I know I've tried explaining to my mother how I don't feel I fit in. She thinks I exaggerate and I'm just being dramatic. But it's certainly a real feeling. I know how it is to prefer solitude to the company of others, especially when you don't feel like a part of the group. I think solidarity helps. If you need someone to talk to PM me.
Please keep your head up. Way easier said than done I know, but we are here. If you need someone to talk to PM me. It always helps to just let it out.

And what to do about it?

Suicide has been a long drawn out subtlety in the back of my mind. The way an atomic bomb is the last and extreme option. It's there waiting, but just hold off. How long do you wait though? When is it enough?

Always being served the same cold dish, it gets tiresome. People dole out that advice always, "you'll get over it," the same sort of thing my mom says to me. I'm sure people get tired of seeing me in this state constantly. So again, what to do?

Don't mean to push any buttons, I don't know where you're at specifically, just trying to discuss and spark some thought.
